aitracking: Measure the Effects of AI Coding Using the GitHub API

Source: R/aitracking-package.R
aitracking-package.Rd

A lightweight pipeline to measure the effects of AI-assisted coding on software projects using the GitHub REST API. Retrieves commit histories (including lines added and deleted), issue and pull request activity, download and clone statistics, and the evolution of a project's size in lines of code by language. Provides a parsimonious, rule-based classifier to flag commits and interactions in which AI coding agents were involved, and base-graphics visualizations of project activity over time. API access is implemented with base R connections to keep dependencies to a minimum.
